propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the checked-out patchset tree and hard-fails when absent, but Gerrit's Verified lane runs the workflow definition from main, causing any change branched before the gate merged to fail despite not touching Git-version-related code

Changes 1408/1410/1411/1416 that predate gate commit c433663721 are incorrectly marked Verified -1 even when their changes are unrelated to Git versions, because they lack the floor file in their tree
The gate's error message 'missing <floorfile>' misleads authors to hunt for a file they never touched rather than naming the real remedy (rebase or wait for post-merge)

The repository's own convention (documented in ee2a) mandates that gate steps reading repo artifacts must skip with a log line when the artifact is absent from the checked-out tree, but the Git floor gate violates this pattern
Applying the if-present guard preserves 980d's enforcement for trees that have the floor file while allowing pre-gate changes to pass, with the skip log explaining the tree-skew cause
